title: Entropy-driven length curator for microbatch slimming and prefill-aware padding eviction
creator: Priya Nair
description:
Goal: reduce padding overhead and tail latency by dynamically shaping microbatches using a light-weight per-request length/entropy signal and a prefill-aware eviction policy. This ticket implements an "entropy-driven length curator" that groups requests by predicted effective sequence length (not just input token count) and applies a selective padding-eviction pass during prefill scheduling.

Motivation: Current padding strategy buckets on raw input token count which overestimates compute for requests with high compressibility or predictable short prefixes (e.g., short prompts with long autocomplete). That leads to unnecessary padding, higher per-token cost, and slower throughput. We want a runtime-guided grouping signal that: 1) improves kernel selection (short-seq fused kernels vs long-seq tiled kernels), 2) reduces KV cache and attention footprint by trimming padding earlier in the pipeline, and 3) maintains 95th/99th latency SLOs for latency-sensitive routes.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype integrated into runtime staging and gated behind a feature flag
End-to-end padding token reduction >= 6 percentage points on production-like traces (measured across 1M requests) without increasing 95th latency by more than 10% relative to baseline
Kernel hinting metadata emitted per microbatch (short|mid|long) and validated to influence kernel selection during prefill in >95% of eligible cases
Automated test coverage for entropy estimator, bucket assignment, and prefill-eviction logic
Confluence design doc, benchmark report, and a follow-up rollout plan (canary -> staged) linked from the ticket
steps: Spike: implement lightweight entropy proxy (byte n-gram / subword-lm logprob delta) to estimate effective length - DONE (spike branch)
Design: define bucket thresholds and kernel-hint enums; add prefill metadata schema - IN PROGRESS
Implementation: integrate curator in request dispatcher; emit kernel_hint and prefill_priority fields
Prefill scheduling: implement padding-eviction pass that trims trailing pad tokens based on predicted decode horizon
Benchmarks: run A/B against baseline on staging traces (1M requests) and capture token-level cost, latency P50/P95/P99, and GPU utilization
Rollout: enable feature-flag for 10% traffic, monitor console dashboards and cost signals, iterate on thresholds
Postmortem: capture regressions, update guidance for model owners, and add to runtime tuning cookbook
technical_notes: Entropy estimator: use a tiny subword LM (40k param distil) that runs on CPU in ~50us per request; fallback to avg token length when disabled
Bucket strategy: three-point classification (SHORT < 64 eff-tokens, MID 64-512, LONG > 512). These thresholds are tunable and derived from production seqlen CDFs.
Kernel hints: hint_short -> fused_mha_fastpath; hint_mid -> tiled_fused; hint_long -> sparse/tiled with attention chunking

Prefill-aware eviction: if predicted decode horizon < bucket_max_margin, trim trailing pads and set microbatch_slot to compacted length. Must preserve reproducibility for sampling-mode requests (seed/temperature issues).
KV cache policy: when reclaiming slots from padding eviction, prefer LRU across requests within same tenant and avoid evicting pinned entries for long-running streams
Safety: conservative mode disables eviction for routes marked 'high-consistency' and preserves current behavior
Metrics to emit: padding_tokens_pct, effective_length_dist, kernel_hint_counts, prefill_eviction_count, microbatch_utilization

Known trade-offs: estimator error may underpredict long decodes leading to decode stalls. We mitigate with conservative slack factor (+10% horizon) and an online guard that switches microbatch to 'conservative' if prefill-decode mismatch rate exceeds threshold
comments: 2026-03-01 Priya: Spike completed. Prototype runs in staging with a naive subword-lm entropy proxy. Baseline padding_tokens_pct=27.3%, prototype=19.1% on sampled traces (non-production sample). CPU overhead ~0.06ms/request.

2026-03-03 Diego: Reviewed prototype. Observed a small number of underpredictions causing decoder re-inserts. Added conservative slack parameter and a guard to reassign microbatch to conservative kernel at decode time if mismatch detected.

2026-03-05 QA: Ran 1M request A/B on staging. Padding reduction median 7.4ppt, cost savings ~5.8% on token-billing equivalent. P95 latency increased 4.2% for MID bucket; investigating headroom and kernel switching latency.
2026-03-07 Priya: Updated prefill pass to emit kernel_hint metadata. Kernel selector accepted hints in 98% of cases; remaining 2% were incompatible due to mixed-tenant constraints.
2026-03-09 Marcus (Infra): Noted spike in GPU occupancy variance when enabling for long tail; recommended limiting initial rollout to routes with P50 < 150ms to avoid cascading backpressure.
2026-03-10 Diego: Preparing PR to add end-to-end tests and feature flag gating. Next: schedule 10% canary, add dashboard widgets for prefill_eviction_count and decode-mismatch-rate.
